title: Work in Progress Seminar
description: This seminar offers a forum for students to discuss what makes for a strong piece of scholarship and how to improve their own research. Seminar time will be divided between considering exemplars or models of scholarship identified by seminar participants and discussing students' own work in progress. The seminar is intended for students at all points of their graduate career, from those interested in developing a seminar paper up to and through those interested in feedback on a dissertation chapter.
